title: Drafts Are Circulating

mood.label: Uneasy thaw 🌥️
mood.summary: Forty-seven, a point up. Hormuz drafts circulating, Brent under $79, the Dow past 54,000 — against fifteen killed near Kyiv, 88 dead at Ceuta, Ebola intensifying in Congo, Europe past 40C and 700 structures gone at Spokane.

lines: Qatar says the drafts are going round the table,
Brent slips under seventy-nine and the Dow finds air.
Somewhere a number ticks past fifty-four thousand
and the room lets out a breath it borrowed.
Forty-seven — a thaw you can't stand on.
The good news came by wire, the rest came by name.
Fifteen near Kyiv, eighty-eight off Ceuta;
the ledger and the list don't say the same.
Europe past forty in the shade of nothing,
seven hundred homes gone where the Spokane wind turned.
Congo counts again. A spent rocket meets the moon.
All of it true before the market opens.
